description: This file defines the OptionalFieldController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and includes a method to set up a Vue component called 'optional-field-list' before rendering.

classes.name: OptionalFieldController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling optional fields in the PIM plugin, extending the AbstractVueController to integrate Vue.js components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component 'optional-field-list' before rendering the view.
